exclusion_reason: The ratcheting coverage bar is implemented in the planning validator: the frozen floor record refuses a merge that lowers the test declaration count, and the orphan rule refuses a runtime module that no test or module reaches. The benchmark remains red because the surface-to-benchmark linkage rule is only partially expressible while most surfaces are CLI-level and the runtime benchmark coverage is still zero.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the gate rejects a benchmark-less runtime surface and a coverage drop below the floor in a drill.
expected_failing_assertion: No coverage ratchet exists in the gate.
active_gate_evidence: The governance gate counts the test declaration against the committed floor record and refuses an orphan runtime module; both rules fail closed.
procedure: Land a drill runtime surface without a benchmark and assert the gate fails.
Drop runtime-module coverage below the floor and assert the gate fails.
Restore both and assert the gate passes.
pass_criterion: Coverage below the floor fails the gate.
